ch3-story-so-far.title: CHAPTER 3 - THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-story-so-far.subtitle: The Story So Far
ch3-story-so-far.text:
A few weeks have passed since the watchtower burned down. In the process of clearing out its remnants, the badly burned body of Vera Brass is found. All of Bird's Nest mourns her passing.

"I can't believe she's gone," says Master Bram at her funeral. "I really thought she would be the one to reach Gaia."

No other bodies were found at the site, leaving the location of Vera's brother Elias a mystery. Her delversuit is also still missing, adding weight to the theory that Elias may have run off into the Tide with it.

With the watchtower cleared, rebuilding efforts begin. It will be months before it is fully functional, but enough has been restored for delving to commence once more.
ch3-story-so-far.footnote: Vera Brass is crossed off the Campaign Sheet. If you still hold the Vera Ally opinion card, discard it.

ch3-quest-report-intro.title: CHAPTER 3 - THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-quest-report-intro.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-quest-report-intro.text:
It is once again time for you to venture into the Tide. You can complete up to 2 Quests from your Open Quests before continuing the story in the Chapter 3 Town Visit.

Choose the Quest you will attempt first. You must attempt at least one Quest before the Town Visit.
ch3-quest-report-intro.footnote: Collectively gain 2 Story tokens - one per Quest you can complete before this Town Visit.

ch3-quest-report.title: CHAPTER 3 - THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-quest-report.subtitle: Quest Report
ch3-quest-report.text: Attempt another Quest, or continue to the Town Visit. Each Quest you play spends a Story token.

ch3-q3-play.title: QUEST #03: XAVIER'S REQUEST
ch3-q3-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q3-play.text: Xavier needs a Tidebloom sample taken from the infected creatures of the Tide. His assistant will meet you out there. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q4-play.title: QUEST #04: A HAND OUTSTRETCHED
ch3-q4-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q4-play.text: Dahlia waits at the edge of the Mistwood, petals glowing faintly, ready to lead you to her kin. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q5-play.title: QUEST #05: THE ROGUE DELVER
ch3-q5-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q5-play.text: The tracks matching Vera Brass' delversuit head west, deeper into the Tide. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q6-play.title: QUEST #06: THE FORGOTTEN VAULT
ch3-q6-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q6-play.text: Mr. Aguilar's map is a tangle of scribbles and crosses leading into the ruins of Second Nest. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q7-play.title: QUEST #07: FURTHER AFIELD
ch3-q7-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q7-play.text: The signal from Vera Brass' delversuit points west, to the ruins of High Nest. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q13-play.title: QUEST #13: UNDERNEATH THE WATCHTOWER
ch3-q13-play.subtitle: Into the Tide
ch3-q13-play.text: A green hatch lies hidden beneath the burned watchtower. Witness hums beside you, ready to go.

ch3-q7-return.title: CHAPTER 3 - THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-q7-return.subtitle: Back from the Tide
ch3-q7-return.text: You make your way back to Bird's Nest.

ch3-q7-conclusion.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-conclusion.subtitle: Further Afield
ch3-q7-conclusion.text:
You pass through the silent, mighty ruins of High Nest, the city that fell from the sky. Your tracking signal points straight through a reinforced metal door. "Hello? Is anyone in here? We mean no harm."

A machine powers up and a red glow lights the room. A large robot is aiming a laser gun straight at you. "YOU ARE NOT WELCOME HERE. YOU HAVE 10 SECONDS TO EVACUATE. TEN. NINE..." Witness moves fearlessly towards it; several beeps and whirrs pass between them, and the robot lowers its weapon and steps away from the door.

"Damn it all! I knew I couldn't trust that bloody robot!" A bespectacled man hides behind a desk, aiming a shaking weapon at you. "Elias? You're Elias Brass, right?" "No, I'm not! Just leave and pretend you never saw me!"

"Mr. Elias? I'm scared..." Two children peek out from behind the desk, a girl of about 4 and a boy of around 9. You assure him you're here to help, and tell him about Margaret Woo and Baby Janus. He slowly lowers his weapon. "So she didn't make it... Wait! Baby Janus! I left him with Margaret." You tell him Janus is in the care of Master Bram, and his eyes narrow. "Can we really trust Bram, or anyone from Bird's Nest?"

You have so many questions and not a lot of time. Better make it count.
ch3-q7-conclusion.footnote: One player converses with Elias. A hidden dial (starting at 0) tracks how much he opens up.

choices.label: "I know you've been through a lot, but I need answers. What happened at the watchtower exactly?"
"You need to start explaining some things. What did Vera tell you when you found her?"

ch3-q7-talk-1.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-1.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-1.text: Elias sighs deeply. "Margaret Woo was trying to contact the delvers. She got me instead. I tried to alert Vera, but we were attacked by some monster and I couldn't do anything except run. I left my sister behind..."

choices.label: "You're not a delver. It would've been foolish to stay. You mentioned a monster... What did it look like?"
"Your sister was trying to save your life. She wanted you to escape. Did you see anything else?"

ch3-q7-talk-2.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-2.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-2.text: "She wasn't making a lot of sense. She said 20 years ago when she made it to Gaia, she was taken to another place. Eden, she called it. But she said it wasn't what was promised, and that's why she escaped."

choices.label: "And the children? Where did they come from? Did she take them from Eden?"
"What was wrong with Eden? Why did Margaret want to escape?"

ch3-q7-talk-3.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-3.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-3.text: Elias takes a deep breath, relieved. "Look, I'm not trying to be difficult. After all that's happened, my head's all scrambled. I don't know who to trust."

choices.label: "It's alright, I understand. Can you at least tell me about what happened at the watchtower?"
"Listen, I'll do whatever I can to help you. I swear I only want to help."

ch3-q7-talk-4.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-4.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-4.text: Elias frowns slightly. "I didn't see much through the smoke. It was huge though, with a giant clawed arm. Vera was fighting it and I swear I saw someone---" He trails off, falling silent.

choices.label: "What else did you see? Please, anything you remember could help us."

ch3-q7-talk-5.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-5.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-5.text: "Someone in a lab coat. I couldn't see their face through the smoke. I think this person is the one that let that creature loose, the one who set fire to the watchtower." He looks around like he's suddenly afraid. "Look, whoever killed Margaret Woo must still be looking for the children. Can you help us?"
ch3-q7-talk-5.footnote: Increase Elias Brass's opinion and gain the Elias Ally opinion card.

choices.label: "I'll help in any way we can."
"I wish I could, but I have other responsibilities I cannot abandon. Bird's Nest is counting on me."

ch3-q7-talk-6.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-6.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-6.text: Suspicion flashes across Elias's features. "I don't know. And even if I did, I wouldn't tell you." He fears for the children's safety and doesn't fully trust you yet.

choices.label: "These children may have been kidnapped for all we know. Now tell me where they came from!"
"Fine. I won't press you if you're not ready to talk about that."

ch3-q7-talk-7.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-7.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-7.text: "I don't know, but she referred to Eden as a prison a few times. I think that robot out there was some kind of guard that Margaret reprogrammed to protect them. Whoever was chasing us was willing to kill her to keep her silent." He looks around like he's suddenly afraid. "Look, whoever killed Margaret Woo must still be looking for the children. Can you help us?"

choices.label: "Of course. I'll help in any way we can."
"I wish I could, but I have other responsibilities I cannot abandon. Bird's Nest is counting on me."

ch3-q7-talk-8.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-8.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-8.text: Elias glares at you. "I don't know, ok?! Whatever answers you're looking for, I don't have them." He puts his arms around the two children. "Right now all I care about is taking care of Oscar and Savannah. I can't protect baby Janus anymore, but I'm not letting anyone from Bird's Nest near these two."
ch3-q7-talk-8.footnote: Decrease Elias Brass's opinion and gain the Elias Detractor opinion card.

ch3-q7-talk-9.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-9.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-9.text: "Thank you." Elias's words come out in a long exhale. "When I saw you were a delver, I allowed myself to hope... I hoped you'd be a friend, not a foe."

ch3-q7-talk-10.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-talk-10.subtitle: Elias Brass
ch3-q7-talk-10.text: Elias's shoulders slump. "I understand. We'll manage... somehow."

ch3-q7-trusted.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-trusted.subtitle: A Safe Cave
ch3-q7-trusted.text:
"When the coast is clear, we're gonna head into the Tide," Elias says, looking out into the darkness. "On my way here, I found a cave that should be safe for us to hide in." He looks at Oscar and Savannah. "I don't know how to explain it, but these children... they can repel the Tide somehow." You explain that baby Janus had the same ability, and he nods.

He turns back to you with a steely gaze. "You better make sure baby Janus is taken care of. Master Bram was always good to me and Vera. I'm going to choose to believe he'll do the right thing."
ch3-q7-trusted.footnote: Continue from a Secret Town Visit.

ch3-q7-cold.title: QUEST #07 CONCLUSION
ch3-q7-cold.subtitle: Good Luck
ch3-q7-cold.text:
Elias gives you a cold look and starts responding to your questions with shrugs. Whatever he knows, he doesn't trust you enough to tell you.

When you tell him you need to head out, he nods curtly. "Good luck. We'll wait til the coast is clear and then head into the Tide. I ran across a cave that should be safe for us to hide in. Go, we'll be fine. That robot will protect us." You bid them good luck and depart.

ch3-q7-hideout-1.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-1.subtitle: Elias' Secret Hideout: Part 1
ch3-q7-hideout-1.text:
The ruins of High Nest - First Nest, they called it once - are an endless mess of broken stone and twisted beams, covered with moss, grass and flowers. Elias has set up camp in what was once a grocery store. Savannah hums a nursery rhyme while Oscar runs around with a toy airplane, going "BRUMMMMMMMM".

"I'm famished, aren't you? Could you help me gather supplies for dinner?" You nod and scour the shelves.

choices.label: A bag of dried lentils, half full but sealed
A tin of mystery stew with a rust-spotted lid
A box of powdered milk, damp around the corners

ch3-q7-hideout-1a.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-1a.subtitle: Lentils
ch3-q7-hideout-1a.text: After simmering, the lentils soften into a rich, filling base. You top it off with scavenged seaweed and Tidegazer meat. It's the best meal you've had in days - warm, nourishing, and most of all, safe.
ch3-q7-hideout-1a.footnote: Each player gains +1 Rank of an Equipment Slot of their choice.

ch3-q7-hideout-1b.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-1b.subtitle: Mystery Stew
ch3-q7-hideout-1b.text: The mystery stew is edible but bland. It fills your bellies, but no one is excited for seconds.
ch3-q7-hideout-1b.footnote: Choose a player to gain +1 Rank of an Equipment Slot of their choice.

ch3-q7-hideout-1c.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-1c.subtitle: Powdered Milk
ch3-q7-hideout-1c.text: Within an hour, stomachs cramp and nausea spreads through the group. The milk had long since spoiled. Only after 48 hours of suffering do you begin to feel human again.

ch3-q7-hideout-2.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-2.subtitle: Elias' Secret Hideout: Part 2
ch3-q7-hideout-2.text: After spending some quality time with Elias and the toddlers, he begins to loosen up. You wait until the kids are napping, crack open a couple of bottles of water, and ask him the question that's been on your mind.

choices.label: Press for more information about the children
Press for more information about why Elias is so adamant on becoming Janus' guardian

ch3-q7-hideout-2a.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-2a.subtitle: Where She Crossed Over
ch3-q7-hideout-2a.text:
"Alright, I'll tell you. I used to spend most of my free time at my post at the watchtower. One day, I received a radio transmission from Margaret Woo - the famous delver that reached Gaia 20 years ago and disappeared. She claimed she was on the run with some kids, that she'd been abducted all this time but found a way to escape, some wild accusations about Father Flores - then the transmission cut out. I told people about it, but no one believed me. Except for my sister Vera.

So I went to find Margaret Woo. And I did find her, but I must have been followed, because Father Flores was hot on my trail. Margaret said he was a Warden. I don't know what she meant by that, but she asked me to take the kids while she dealt with Flores. And again, like the coward I am, I let her die while I ran away. I even left a kid behind in my rush for the exit. And that's why we're here."

"As for your question, I don't know where the children came from exactly, but Woo showed me where she crossed over - she said we should meet there if she survived."
ch3-q7-hideout-2a.footnote: Add Quest #08 "The Bridge" (a Memory Chip if already owned or completed). Add Key Item #13.

ch3-q7-hideout-2b.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-hideout-2b.subtitle: Not Human
ch3-q7-hideout-2b.text:
"Alright, I'll tell you. I used to spend most of my free time at my post at the watchtower. One day, I received a radio transmission from Margaret Woo - the famous delver that reached Gaia 20 years ago and disappeared. She claimed she was on the run with some kids, that she'd been abducted all this time but found a way to escape, some wild accusations about Father Flores - then the transmission cut out. I told people about it, but no one believed me. Except for my sister Vera.

So I went to find Margaret Woo. And I did find her, but I must have been followed, because Father Flores was hot on my trail. Margaret said he was a Warden. I don't know what she meant by that, but she asked me to take the kids while she dealt with Flores. And again, like the coward I am, I let her die while I ran away. I even left a kid behind in my rush for the exit. And that's why we're here."

"As for your question, if Father Flores realizes Janus is at Bird's Nest, he'll kill him. For a brief moment I saw Flores' true face as he was slaughtering Margaret. Whatever he is, he's not human."
ch3-q7-hideout-2b.footnote: Add Quest #09 "Sins of the Father" (a Memory Chip if already owned or completed). Add Key Item #13.

ch3-q7-scavenge.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-scavenge.subtitle: Elias' Scavenge Shop
ch3-q7-scavenge.text: Shop Products #32-45 that nobody owns and that aren't already in your Purchasable Products are for sale during this Secret Town Visit only. There is only one of each product. You may convert a Boss part into minion parts at 3 minion parts per level of the Boss part.
ch3-q7-scavenge.postRewardsText: When everyone is done shopping, click Continue. Unbought scavenge products go back to the box.

ch3-q7-scavenge-close.title: SECRET TOWN VISIT - IN THE RUINS OF HIGH NEST
ch3-q7-scavenge-close.subtitle: End of Secret Town Visit
ch3-q7-scavenge-close.text: You bid Elias, Oscar and Savannah farewell. When you're ready, choose any Open Quest to attempt.
ch3-q7-scavenge-close.footnote: This Town Visit isn't marked on your Campaign Sheet.

ch3-arrival.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-arrival.subtitle: The Festival Begins
ch3-arrival.text: It's evening when you ascend from the mist. Off in the distance you hear the low thumping of a bass drum. Aid is provided to you quickly and efficiently as you are waved forward to the festival that has already begun.

ch3-died.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-died.subtitle: The Fallen
ch3-died.text: You bring your fallen delvers home to Bird's Nest. Their final words are already recorded in the Graveyard on your Campaign Sheet.
ch3-died.footnote: If the delver that died is your last remaining Hero card, don't discard them.

ch3-died-mind.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-died-mind.subtitle: Mind Delver's Blood-Soaked Suit
ch3-died-mind.text: Blood seeps into the crevices of the Delversuit, filling it with new power.
ch3-died-mind.footnote: Add Rank 1 of any one Equipment to an Equipment Slot of your choice on the Suit Condition sheet.

ch3-died-body.subtitle: Body Delver's Blood-Soaked Suit
ch3-died-body.text: Blood seeps into the crevices of the Delversuit, filling it with new power.

ch3-died-both.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-died-both.subtitle: Both Delvers' Blood-Soaked Suit
ch3-died-both.text: Blood seeps into the crevices of the Delversuit, filling it with new power.

ch3-new-recruits.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-new-recruits.subtitle: Meet the New Recruits
ch3-new-recruits.text: As you make your way to the courtyard, two fresh graduates fall in step beside you, eager to see their first Memorial Festival as delvers.
ch3-new-recruits.footnote: Disciple of the Mind player gains Hero #7. Disciple of the Body player gains Hero #8.

ch3-festival-1.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL - PART 1
ch3-festival-1.subtitle: A Night to Remember
ch3-festival-1.text:
The courtyard is lit with hanging lanterns and string lights, enveloping the people of Bird's Nest in a warm glow. Joyful music plays as people dance on the cobbled yard, sharing food and drinks.

Elayna Woo is at the bar, swirling a drink in her hand. Her eyes have a faraway look to them, and they seem to be brimming with tears.

While Father Flores is helping serve food for the guests, Dr Ira is talking to him in a frantic whisper. You wonder why she seems so agitated.

Xavier is intently looking at a potted plant that seems to be glowing and swaying slightly to the music.

At the nearby tables, Samantha is playing cards with one of her delver cousins. "Hey, you two! Care for a game of cards? Carlos here isn't giving me much of a challenge."

choices.label: Attempt to eavesdrop on Flores and Ira's conversation

ch3-f1-a.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-a.subtitle: Elayna
ch3-f1-a.text:
Elayna frantically wipes at her eyes when she notices you approach.

"We're here to honor all the delvers who made it to Gaia," she says quietly. "Y'know... I was only 7 when Margaret went into the Tide for the last time. I made her promise she'd return. But she never did. Maybe she had no choice. Or maybe salvation was better than coming home to an annoying little sister."

There's a bitterness in her voice you've never heard before. After a moment, she gives you a sad smile, grateful for your listening ear.
ch3-f1-a.footnote: Increase Elayna's opinion. Unless Elayna's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-f1-b.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-b.subtitle: Eavesdropping
ch3-f1-b.text: You're not hungry, but if you pretend to get some food maybe you can overhear Father Flores and Dr Ira's conversation.

ch3-f1-b-fail.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-b-fail.subtitle: Too Eager
ch3-f1-b-fail.text: You inch along the line, eyes focused on the pair. But you're too eager and bump into the person in front of you, dropping your plate and making a mess. An irritated Dr Ira reprimands you. "Be more careful, delvers! We don't have food to spare here, as you well know."
ch3-f1-b-fail.footnote: The active delver loses 2 minion parts.

ch3-f1-b-success.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-b-success.subtitle: Abducted Kin
ch3-f1-b-success.text:
As you inch along, you overhear Dr Ira saying, "Flores, burying your head in the sand will solve nothing. The Tidekin threat draws nearer every day. By the time they're at our doorstep, it'll be too late!"

Flores quietly but firmly responds, "You exaggerate as always, Doctor. We've maintained peaceful, if distant, relations with the Tidekin for generations and this situation will be no different. Their accusations that we've abducted their kin are troubling, of course, but cooler heads will prevail. Now, if you'll excuse me..." Father Flores disappears into the crowd.

ch3-f1-c.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-c.subtitle: Speed
ch3-f1-c.text:
Samantha challenges you to a game of Speed, which she proceeds to trounce you at repeatedly.

"How on earth did you manage to survive all those monsters when you can't even escape my hand!" she playfully taunts.
ch3-f1-c.footnote: Increase Samantha's opinion. Unless Samantha's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-f1-d.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f1-d.subtitle: Tidal Plant Morphology
ch3-f1-d.text: "Excellent. I planted this flower in the Tide weeks ago. Now look at how it reacts to music. It's moving! The fascinating thing is--" Xavier proceeds to regale you with details about the strange and wonderful world of tidal plant morphology.
ch3-f1-d.footnote: Increase Xavier's opinion. Unless Xavier's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-festival-2.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL - PART 2
ch3-festival-2.subtitle: Lights Out
ch3-festival-2.text:
Master Bram steps up to the podium and smiles at his audience as the music dies down.

"I want to thank everyone for being here. Tonight, we honor the delvers who journeyed through the Tide, faced insurmountable odds, and reached Gaia. Though they left us... ascended for the survival of our people, their presence is felt still. To Margaret Woo, Jonah Stone, and every other delver that came before them - we honor you with this work of art."

Bram pulls a woolen tarp off a giant sculpted-metal canvas: armored delvers stand triumphantly in the foreground, the Gaia monolith behind them. "We raise a glass to you." Glasses clink - and suddenly all the lights go out, not just in the courtyard but across all of Bird's Nest. "Oh no, my dad!" Rodrigo's voice rings out in the darkness.

Master Bram lights a lantern and the crowd calms down a little. "Sam, you know what to do. Delvers, give her a hand." Witness's eyes light your path down to the nearest generator. Sparks fly from giant claw marks torn into its casing, and a purple substance sizzles on its side.

"I don't like this," Sam says quietly. While she starts the repairs, you look for clues.

choices.label: Examine the claw marks more closely

ch3-f2-a.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f2-a.subtitle: Claw Marks
ch3-f2-a.text: The giant claws ripped a chunk out of the generator's outer protector. Your eyes zero in on a bright green speck - paint chips. The color is familiar, but right now you cannot place it.

ch3-f2-b.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL
ch3-f2-b.subtitle: The Substance
ch3-f2-b.text: Smoke rises from drops of purple liquid on the ground. You uncork a small glass vial from your utility belt and take a sample, but the liquid burns a hole through the glass. You store the remnants for later.

ch3-festival-3.title: THE MEMORIAL FESTIVAL - PART 3
ch3-festival-3.subtitle: The Culprit
ch3-festival-3.text:
"Here goes nothing..." Sam murmurs. Light returns to Bird's Nest. Nearby, Witness lets out a piercing beep - you find a hulking creature collapsed on the ground, smoke rising from its slimy form. With Witness's help, you drag it to the courtyard.

Bram studies the creature in grim silence. "Gaia protect us..." Dr Ira whispers, looking at it in horror. "I was afraid of this... I warned Father Flores. The Tidekin are upon us." The crowd begins clamoring for answers.

"The Tidekin are not known to be aggressive." Xavier's calm voice lingers in the air.

Ira's eyes flash over to him. "Tell that to the people that were killed in the Burning Fields, like my parents. I know you have a soft spot for the creatures of the Tide, Xavier. But open your eyes!"

Bram steps in between them. "Now's not the time, and nobody should jump to conclusions. The celebration is clearly over. Dr Ira, I suspect you have patients to attend to." He turns to the crowd. "Trust me, the delvers will get to the bottom of this."

ch3-bram-comm.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-bram-comm.subtitle: A Comm from Master Bram
ch3-bram-comm.text:
Nearly a week has gone by, but the ripples from the outage are still felt throughout Bird's Nest. You receive a comm from Bram early in the morning.

"You did great work on the night of the outage, delvers. The fire at the watchtower and the generator attack... they must be connected. But we won't find the answers sitting around. Dr Ira's performing an autopsy on the creature you found. I'm meeting Headmistress Arlen at the Delving Academy to see if we can make sense of this. We'll speak later."

With some time on your hands, you wonder how you can help.
ch3-bram-comm.footnote: Collectively gain 4 Story tokens - these represent the total number of locations you can visit this Chapter.

ch3-hub.title: CHAPTER 3 - TOWN VISIT
ch3-hub.subtitle: Explore the Town
ch3-hub.text: Choose a location to visit. Each visit spends 1 Story token. Once they're spent, head to the Town Center.

choices.label: Meet Doctor Ira at the Crypt
Join the congregation at the Temple of Gaia
See what Xavier is up to

ch3-crypt.title: THE CRYPT
ch3-crypt.subtitle: Dr Ira's Autopsy
ch3-crypt.text:
The crypt is a mortuary built into the caverns at the base of Bird's Nest. Dr Ira sighs when she sees you, but softens when you tell her Bram didn't send you. The creature is so massive her assistants made a table from a concrete slab.

"Its heart seems to have stopped, possibly from electrocution after it attacked the generator. It once stood on two powerful legs and used its giant claws for movement as well."

You ask whether it's connected to the watchtower. "Almost certainly. When I did the autopsy on Vera Brass, I found that she did not die from smoke inhalation. She died from blood loss, and her body had giant gashes consistent with this creature's physiology."

ch3-crypt-a.title: THE CRYPT
ch3-crypt-a.subtitle: Green Paint
ch3-crypt-a.text: Examining the creature's claws you see green paint flakes, and your mind flashes with a memory: at the watchtower, there's a hatch leading to the basement in the exact same color. When Dr Ira notices this, she quickly covers the creature. "Sorry delvers, if you'll excuse me, I have more work to do."
ch3-crypt-a.footnote: Add Quest #13 "Underneath the Watchtower". If already owned or completed, instead gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-crypt-b.title: THE CRYPT
ch3-crypt-b.subtitle: Dr Ira's Notes
ch3-crypt-b.text: While Dr Ira is busy packing up her samples, you glance at her notes. "Internal physiology resembles Sirens, which are docile creatures. These Tidekin - assuredly not."
ch3-crypt-b.footnote: Add a Friendly Spawn Card to the Spawn Deck.

ch3-temple.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple.subtitle: A Troubled Sermon
ch3-temple.text:
A bell is ringing as you arrive. The temple is adorned with wooden carvings lit by flickering candlelight - one depicts a city on fire, another a monolith holding back a giant wave.

Father Flores climbs the podium. He hasn't been seen since the power outage, and he looks tired and disheveled, a rarity for someone so put-together. Most concerning, he seems to have been injured and walks with a limp.

By an altar away from the crowd, Rodrigo is quietly praying, face wet with tears.

choices.label: Go to the front row and listen
Sneak into the back room while the Father is distracted

ch3-temple-a.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple-a.subtitle: The Story of Eleanor
ch3-temple-a.text:
"What is being done about those creatures?" someone cries out. "The delvers have their suits. What chance do the rest of us stand?!"

"You are not in danger," Father Flores responds, exasperated. "Your fear only betrays your lack of faith. Recall the story of Eleanor, Gaia's most faithful - not a fighter, not a delver, but a simple farmer. She knew her duty and fulfilled it without question, and Gaia saved her."

He notices you listening intently and gives you an approving nod.
ch3-temple-a.footnote: Increase Father Flores' opinion. Unless Flores's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-temple-b.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple-b.subtitle: The Back Room
ch3-temple-b.text: While Father Flores struggles to give his sermon, you edge towards the back room.

ch3-temple-b-fail.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple-b-fail.subtitle: Caught
ch3-temple-b-fail.text: In your rush, you knock over a candelabra, which clatters on the tiles. Father Flores hurries over despite his injuries. "I will not hazard a guess as to what you think you are doing - I have too much on my hands. You must leave. Now."
ch3-temple-b-fail.footnote: Decrease Father Flores' opinion. Unless Flores's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-temple-b-success.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple-b-success.subtitle: The Brass Dossier
ch3-temple-b-success.text:
The back room where Father Flores lives is plain and unadorned. Behind the shelves of a cabinet you find a dossier labelled "Brass".

If you've completed Quest #05, the dossier's notes track Vera Brass' movements - including an active tracking device. Her delversuit was last seen far to the west near the ruins of High Nest. You take the folder and quickly leave.
ch3-temple-b-success.footnote: If you've completed Quest #05: add Quest #07 "Further Afield" (or a Memory Chip if already owned). Otherwise: gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-temple-c.title: THE TEMPLE OF GAIA
ch3-temple-c.subtitle: Rodrigo
ch3-temple-c.text:
Rodrigo is deep in mourning and can't even muster his usual smile. You offer your condolences.

"When you and Sam got the generator running again, I hoped not too much time had passed. But by the time we made it to the clinic and turned the ventilator back on, my dad--" He trails off. You put an arm around him and stay with him for some time.
ch3-temple-c.footnote: Increase Rodrigo's opinion. Unless Rodrigo's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-shadow.title: SHADOW DISTRICT
ch3-shadow.subtitle: Forgotten
ch3-shadow.text:
The Shadow District sits beneath the shade of the mountain. Many failed delvers retreated here, welcomed by others who didn't fit the mold. The power outage lasted days here - further proof, to its people, that they are often forgotten.

Some folks are looting a store; you can hear shouting and furniture being tossed. Elayna kneels beside an injured teen while a man yells at her to help his mother. A disheveled woman shouts about mysterious sounds from the sewers.

ch3-shadow-a.title: SHADOW DISTRICT
ch3-shadow-a.subtitle: The Brawl
ch3-shadow-a.text: You rush inside and pull two men off each other. The older man accuses the younger of being a thief, so you restrain the latter and call for backup.
ch3-shadow-a.footnote: Shuffle 2 Ultra Level Cards into the Level Deck.

ch3-shadow-b.title: SHADOW DISTRICT
ch3-shadow-b.subtitle: A Helping Hand
ch3-shadow-b.text: You hurry to where the man's injured mother is lying on the floor, carry her to a bed, and help set her twisted ankle. Elayna finishes tending to her. "Thanks, delvers. I've been at this all week! I can finally take a little break."
ch3-shadow-b.footnote: Increase Elayna's opinion. Unless Elayna's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-shadow-c.title: SHADOW DISTRICT
ch3-shadow-c.subtitle: Strange Noises
ch3-shadow-c.text: "Strange noises near the sewers! I've been hearing them for days! But they suddenly stopped when the power went out... Something's not right!" You enter the sewer gate she indicated. It leads through a sloped tunnel for what feels like ages, until at last you reach a green door.
ch3-shadow-c.footnote: Add Quest #13 "Underneath the Watchtower". If already owned or completed, instead gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-machinist.title: MACHINIST
ch3-machinist.subtitle: Shelved Prototypes
ch3-machinist.text:
Samantha is scowling and bouncing a ball against a wall. "That power outage was one giant pain in my neck! I've been going to every generator on Bird's Nest, checking and repairing them. Had to get my cousin Carlos to help or I'd never finish."

Witness lets out a sad whirr. "It's ok, lil guy. I just need something else to do around here." You look around at her shelved prototypes:

Flaming Projectile Prototype - energy requirements impractical. Heat Seeking Experiment - too dangerous to safely test. Synthetic Harvester - untestable in lab setting.
ch3-machinist.footnote: If Samantha's opinion is Ally or better, you gain the product for free instead of adding it to the shop.

choices.label: Tell her the Flaming Projectile prototype shows promise
Show enthusiasm for her Heat Seeking experiment
Offer to help test her Synthetic Harvester

ch3-machinist-a.title: MACHINIST
ch3-machinist-a.subtitle: Back to the Workbench
ch3-machinist-a.text: "You really think so? Alright, I'll finish it then!"
ch3-machinist-a.footnote: Add Shop Product #39 to your Purchasable Products. If Samantha's opinion is Ally or better, gain the product instead.

ch3-machinist-b.title: MACHINIST
ch3-machinist-b.subtitle: Back to the Workbench
ch3-machinist-b.text: "Might be a little risky, but if you think it might help, I'll give it a shot!"
ch3-machinist-b.footnote: Add Shop Product #40 to your Purchasable Products. If Samantha's opinion is Ally or better, gain the product instead.

ch3-machinist-c.title: MACHINIST
ch3-machinist-c.subtitle: Back to the Workbench
ch3-machinist-c.text: "You'd do that for me? Well then, time to give this baby a tune up!"
ch3-machinist-c.footnote: Add Shop Product #36 to your Purchasable Products. If Samantha's opinion is Ally or better, gain the product instead.

ch3-machinist-witness.title: MACHINIST
ch3-machinist-witness.subtitle: Witness Records a Memory
ch3-machinist-witness.text:
Samantha pops open a compartment in Witness' chest, revealing a complex web of circuits and wires. As she scribbles notes, you notice several blackened circuits.

If you carry any Memory Chips, Witness' eyes blaze with light, projecting an image on the wall. "Whoa, what the heck is that?" Samantha exclaims. Thinking quickly, you snap a photo.
ch3-machinist-witness.footnote: Spend your Memory Chip tokens and draw that many Memory Fragment cards.

ch3-academy.title: ACADEMY CAMPUS
ch3-academy.subtitle: A Heated Exchange
ch3-academy.text: Despite the chaos of the power outage, the delving students go about their studies. When you arrive at Headmistress Arlen's office, she and Master Bram are arguing just outside her door. It looks quite heated, which is concerning - the pair are old friends.

ch3-academy-a.title: ACADEMY CAMPUS
ch3-academy-a.subtitle: What We Know
ch3-academy-a.text:
"Vera Brass graduated top of her class. Full honors. But she still died." Arlen's voice is full of grief and rage. "What are we doing here, Bram? Sending these kids to their death! And for what?!"

"Every delver matters to me, Arlen. You know this is the only way--" You interrupt and Bram cuts himself short. "Ah, delvers... I assume you're here to go over what we know so far."
ch3-academy-a.footnote: With 4+ clue icons on your Key Items: add Quest #03 (or #13, or #07 - the first you don't own; a Memory Chip if you own them all). With 0-3: gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-academy-b.title: ACADEMY CAMPUS
ch3-academy-b.subtitle: Overheard
ch3-academy-b.text:
"Vera Brass of all people? Gone, just like that." Arlen's voice is full of emotion. "How many delvers have we lost this year? And Father Flores hasn't said a thing about our fallen delvers. He wants to run the Academy like he runs the Children of Gaia - just moving parts in a machine."

Master Bram pinches the bridge of his nose. "Now I see it. Ira's been whispering in your ear again. We can't afford to--"

They finally notice you listening. Headmistress Arlen glares at you and you excuse yourself.
ch3-academy-b.footnote: Decrease Arlen's opinion. Unless Arlen's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-academy-c.title: ACADEMY CAMPUS
ch3-academy-c.subtitle: Vera's Reports
ch3-academy-c.text: While Bram and Arlen are in a heated exchange, you skirt along the wall behind them and slip into the headmistress's office. On the table are reports Vera Brass submitted on her last run into the Tide, spattered with what appear to be tears. You glean useful information for your next run.
ch3-academy-c.footnote: One player: +1 Armor Rank. One player: +1 Harvester Rank (Suit Condition sheet).

ch3-dahlia.title: DAHLIA'S CAVE
ch3-dahlia.subtitle: Xavier's Mother
ch3-dahlia.text:
You send Xavier a comm about the struggle you faced alongside Dahlia. "Thank you, delvers. After what happened during the power outage, I'm worried about my mother. We should go see her."

Astonishingly, Xavier survives contact with the mist without a delversuit, though he winces, the blue markings on his face glowing bright. In a cave above the mist, Dahlia kneels serenely in a tidal pool, her orchid-petal hair shifting faintly with each breath.

"The burned watchtower, the damaged generator, and the trouble you and mother faced... I have a feeling it's all connected. Do you have any physical evidence? I have an electron microscope we could put to use."

choices.label: Show Xavier the evidence you've assembled so far
Ask Dahlia what the Tidekin are like

ch3-dahlia-a.title: DAHLIA'S CAVE
ch3-dahlia-a.subtitle: Tidebloom
ch3-dahlia-a.text:
Xavier spends an hour meticulously studying your clues.

"Look here, do you see this fungal pattern? This is the Tidebloom I told you about. I believe it's the reason creatures have become more aggressive lately. Until now, though, I've only had scraps to study - this quantity of bloom changes everything."

He stares off into the distance. "Could the creature that attacked the generator have been mutated by this Tidebloom?"
ch3-dahlia-a.footnote: Increase Xavier's opinion. Unless Xavier's opinion is now neutral, gain the matching opinion card.

ch3-dahlia-b.title: DAHLIA'S CAVE
ch3-dahlia-b.subtitle: Not Tidekin
ch3-dahlia-b.text:
Did the Tidekin attack Bird's Nest?

"Of course they didn't!" Xavier responds, but his mother stands and he falls quiet. "Not Tidekin," Dahlia says simply. Her hand is slender, not clawed like the creature you saw. "We help. Tidekin... p-protect life. No hurt. No hurt."

"My mother lived in Bird's Nest years ago," Xavier explains. "When my father was lost in the Tide, she went searching for him, not knowing she was pregnant with me. The Tide doesn't just kill humans - it changes them. She has become a Tidekin, but she is still my mother. The Tidekin are not violent. Somehow, we need to make the people of Bird's Nest understand."
ch3-dahlia-b.footnote: Add Quest #04 "A Hand Outstretched". If already owned or completed, instead gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-town-center.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-town-center.subtitle: Delving Academy Materials Request
ch3-town-center.text:
"Delvers, we've learned much from our previous experiments. It appears that the glow emanating from delversuits is reactive in nature - we've observed the energy within organic particulates transferring into delversuit metals, but more investigation is needed. Can we count on your support?"

Donations count towards your RUNNING total across the campaign. Arlen's reaction hints: about 3 - "What goes around comes around, you know." About 8 - "We'll have to make do with this." About 16 - "Our next set of experiments are off to a strong start thanks to you." About 24 - "This... this is remarkably generous!"
ch3-town-center.footnote: Shop Products #13-18 are now available. With 2+ clue icons on your Key Items, also #19; with 5+, also #20.

ch3-shop.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-shop.subtitle: Visit the Shops
ch3-shop.text: Each player may purchase products using their minion and/or boss parts. You may convert a Boss part into minion parts at 3 minion parts per level of the Boss part. Check your Opinion cards for discounts or markups.
ch3-shop.postRewardsText: When everyone is done shopping, click Continue.

ch3-donation-results.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-donation-results.subtitle: Experimental Division Results
ch3-donation-results.footnote: Running total 6-12: one player +1 OS, other +1 Supercharger. 13-21: +2 OS / +2 Supercharger. 22+: each player +2 Rank of any equipment.

ch3-jobs.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs.subtitle: View the Jobs Board
ch3-jobs.text: The Jobs Board outside the Academy is crowded with requests. Delvers with Open Quests are paid a retainer for each one they're pursuing.

ch3-jobs-retainer.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-retainer.subtitle: Retainer
ch3-jobs-retainer.text: The Academy clerk tallies up your Open Quests and counts out your pay.
ch3-jobs-retainer.footnote: Both delvers gain 1 minion part per Open Quest.

ch3-jobs-roll.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-roll.subtitle: No Open Quests
ch3-jobs-roll.text: You have no Open Quests to show for yourselves. Samantha, posting a request of her own, raises an eyebrow.

ch3-jobs-unimpressed.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-unimpressed.subtitle: Unimpressed
ch3-jobs-unimpressed.text: "Lacklustre investigating, delvers. Bird's Nest deserves better."

ch3-jobs-choice.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-choice.subtitle: Take a Job
ch3-jobs-choice.text:
Two requests catch your eye.

Xavier is soliciting help from a delver. He's been researching a corruption called the Tidebloom that has been spreading, and requests help to collect a sample.

A Shadow District street urchin is selling a copy of a map - "Old Aguilar drew it for his delving partner, back before the Tide took her. Leads to a vault in Second Nest."

choices.label: Xavier needs help collecting a Tidebloom sample
Buy a street urchin's copy of a map to Second Nest (5 minion parts)

ch3-jobs-a.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-a.subtitle: Xavier's Request
ch3-jobs-a.text: You put your name down on Xavier's request.
ch3-jobs-a.footnote: Add Quest #03. If already owned or completed, instead gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-jobs-b.title: TOWN CENTER
ch3-jobs-b.subtitle: The Forgotten Vault
ch3-jobs-b.text: You count out the minion parts. The urchin presses the folded map into your hand and vanishes into the crowd.
ch3-jobs-b.footnote: The paying delver loses 5 minion parts. Add Quest #06 "The Forgotten Vault". If already owned or completed, instead gain a Memory Chip token.

ch3-end.title: END OF CHAPTER 3
ch3-end.subtitle: The Memorial Festival
ch3-end.text: The festival lanterns have long since gone dark, but the questions they lit remain. Somewhere beneath Bird's Nest, something is waiting.
